instruction: Turntable 12-Scene Camera Animation Load `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\product.dae`. It contains a multi-part product model (a chair built from a seat, a backrest, four legs, and a distinguishing armrest on the +X side) centred near the world origin. 1. Define 12 camera viewpoints arranged equally around the world Z axis (azimuth spaced exactly 30 deg apart, starting at 0 deg). Each camera sits at radius `r = 4.0 m` from the Z axis, at height `z = 1.5 m`, and its optical axis points toward the world origin `(0, 0, 0)`. So camera `k` (0-indexed, k = 0..11) is located at: az_k = k * 30 deg pos_k = (4.0 * cos(az_k), 4.0 * sin(az_k), 1.5) look_at_k = (0, 0, 0) up_k = (0, 0, 1) 2. Export a COLLADA scene `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` containing: - the product geometry (reused or re-imported from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\product.dae`), and - 12 `<node>` entries named `Scene_01`.. `Scene_12`, each with a `<camera>` instance. The cameras should be placed at the positions above using `<translate>` + `<rotate>` transforms so the camera looks at the origin. 3. Write a companion JSON `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cameras.json` with the schema: { "cameras": [ {"name": "Scene_01", "azimuth_deg": 0.0, "position": [x, y, z], "look_at": [0, 0, 0], "up": [0, 0, 1]},... {"name": "Scene_12", "azimuth_deg": 330.0, "position": [x, y, z], "look_at": [0, 0, 0], "up": [0, 0, 1]} ] } 4. Render a 12-frame PNG sequence `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\frame_01.png`.. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\frame_12.png` representing the view from each camera. Since headless SketchUp rendering is unavailable, produce the frames via a simple offline projection - for example, perspective-project the mesh vertices to a 2D canvas and draw the silhouette as a black mask on a white background. Each frame must differ visibly from every other frame (the silhouette centroid and/or pixel count must drift as the camera azimuth changes). Outputs under `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sketchup-17/`: - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cameras.json` - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\frame_01.png`.. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\frame_12.png` Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cameras.json` parses as valid JSON with exactly 12 cameras. 2. Camera azimuths are spaced 30 deg apart starting at 0 deg (order-insensitive; tol 1 deg). 3. Every camera position lies on the circle of radius 4.0 m at height 1.5 m (tol 0.02 m). 4. All 12 PNG frames exist and each is a valid PNG with at least 64x64 resolution. 5. At least 10 of the 12 frames are pairwise distinct (silhouette centroid drift > 2 px OR pixel-count delta > 0.5 % of image area). 6. The silhouette centroid x-coordinate sweeps: the standard deviation of the 12 centroid-x values is >= 5 px (i.e. The azimuth variation is actually reflected in the renders).
source: SU-Help Animation export; Chopra-Dummies scenes; COLLADA 1.5 camera + look-at
